differences.how: T-2904, ruled not shadow: the apron's sunlit south face (x 520-526 px, y 684-712) reads 120 against the south wall's 183 beside it in the same light, and both its faces are stippled (sd 13-17 against the smooth wall's 3) where a shaded face would be smooth; its west cheek (87) reads darker than the front's rock-faced stone in the same west light (126). So the apron is a darker, rough stone, and it is laid in one: K08's apron is now a role of its own (`apron`), and 1625's oriel names `apron.fabric` front_stone, so K01's `bay_apron` slot wears the front's rock-faced K02 brownstone under the oriel's pale dressed walls, its foot and underside with it. No tone factor is invented: the front's own stone lands the re-rendered apron at 57 against the south wall's 92 on the south face (0.62, the print's 0.66) and at 95 on the west cheek (0.63 of the front's 151, the print's 0.69).
